evals.name: blog-listing-and-dynamic-detail-page
evals.prompt: This is a Next Rust app. Add a blog: /blog lists the posts (title, date, one-line summary) and /blog/<slug> shows one post. The posts can be a hard-coded list in Rust for now. Visiting a slug that doesn't exist must return a real 404, not an error page. Build it and make sure both pages actually render.
evals.expected_output: app/blog/page.rs and app/blog/[slug]/page.rs (dynamic segment directory), the detail page using params + or_not_found()/not_found, Tailwind classes for styling, and a passing `cargo build` / verified rendering.
assertions: Uses a dynamic segment directory literally named [slug]
load returns Result in the same file, consumed as Data<T>

evals.name: api-route-plus-server-action-form
evals.prompt: In this Next Rust app I need a contact form. Add a POST API route at /api/contact that takes {name, email, message} as JSON and returns the created record, plus a page at /contact with a form that submits without a full page reload and shows a validation error under the email field when it's not a valid email. Keep it server-rendered, no client framework.
evals.expected_output: app/api/contact/route.rs with a POST handler and typed JSON body, a server action for the form (Form!/data-nr-action + data-nr-error wiring) with validation errors returned per field, and a page that renders the form.
assertions: route.rs exports pub async fn POST taking one Request
Invalid email returns 4xx with per-field errors
No-reload form uses #[server_action] + action!, not hand-written fetch
Email error wired via data-nr-error / FormState

evals.name: framework-change-to-embedded-client-runtime
evals.prompt: I'm working on the Next Rust framework itself (this repo). After a client-side navigation finishes, any open <dialog> element should be closed, the same way open <details> menus already are. Make that change in the framework and make sure the whole test suite and CI checks still pass.
evals.expected_output: Edit RUNTIME_JS in crates/next-rust-server/src/client_runtime.rs, regenerate/patch RUNTIME_JS_MIN, update RUNTIME_JS_SOURCE_HASH, keep the public-contract test passing, and run fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests (ideally cargo doc too).
assertions: RUNTIME_JS edited to close open dialogs
cargo test passes including client_runtime tests
No hand-bumped versions, no edits to generated code
